question: Find the total score of all posts authored by users who have at least one post created in 2010, where these posts (not necessarily from 2010) contain 'data visualization' in the title, have at least one favorite, and were last edited by their original owner. Return the sum of scores grouped by the author’s display name.

prediction.sql:
WITH users_with_2010_posts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "XCL_033" AS OwnerUserId
    FROM posts
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', "XCL_029") = '2010'
),
last_edits AS (
    SELECT
        "XCL_014" AS PostId,
        "XCL_017" AS EditorUserId,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "XCL_014" ORDER BY "XCL_016" DESC) AS rn
    FROM postHistory
)
SELECT
    u."XCL_055" AS DisplayName,
    SUM(p."XCL_031") AS TotalScore
FROM posts p
INNER JOIN users u ON p."XCL_033" = u."XCL_052"
INNER JOIN users_with_2010_posts u2010 ON p."XCL_033" = u2010.OwnerUserId
INNER JOIN last_edits le ON p."XCL_026" = le.PostId AND le.rn = 1
WHERE
    p."XCL_035" LIKE '%data visualization%'
    AND p."XCL_039" > 0
    AND le.EditorUserId = p."XCL_033"
GROUP BY
    u."XCL_055"

    SELECT DISTINCT "XCL_033" AS OwnerUserId
    FROM posts
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', "XCL_029") = '2010'
),
last_edits AS (
    SELECT
        "XCL_014" AS PostId,
        "XCL_017" AS EditorUserId,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "XCL_014" ORDER BY "XCL_016" DESC) AS rn
    FROM postHistory
)
SELECT
    u."XCL_055" AS DisplayName,
    SUM(p."XCL_031") AS TotalScore
FROM posts p
INNER JOIN users u ON p."XCL_033" = u."XCL_052"
INNER JOIN users_with_2010_posts u2010 ON p."XCL_033" = u2010.OwnerUserId
INNER JOIN last_edits le ON p."XCL_026" = le.PostId AND le.rn = 1
WHERE
    p."XCL_035" LIKE '%data visualization%'
    AND p."XCL_039" > 0
    AND le.EditorUserId = p."XCL_033"
GROUP BY
    u."XCL_055"
